name: pokemon-tcg-tracker
description: Private, local-first browser tracker for English Pokemon TCG cards.

scripts.desktop:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.qa:static: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.qa:browser: vitest run tests/qa-seed.test.ts tests/qa-report.test.ts tests/qa-runner.test.ts tests/qa-route-prod-gating.test.ts tests/desktop-persistence-diagnostic.test.ts tests/desktop-persistence-diagnostic-live.test.ts tests/qa-max-stress.test.ts
scripts.qa:desktop:manual: echo "See docs/QA_DESKTOP.md — run 'npm run desktop:dev', open #qa, click Reset+Seed+Run, save reports to .local/qa/"
scripts.qa:full: npm run qa:static && npm run qa:browser
